thread.title: Gethsemane Cup Of Suffering And The Sons Substantial Submission To The Father
thread.summary: **`gethsemane-cup-of-suffering-and-the-sons-substantial-submission-to-the-father`** — anchor at Matt 26:36-46. The substantial-Gethsemane substance + the substantial-cup-of-suffering substance per `cup-of-suffering-tanakh-substance` thread (PROPOSED at Matt 20 from S85) + the substantial-Son's-submission-to-the-Father per the Formless-Formed grid per `nature-of-god-formed-in-flesh` thread. Framework rules out Trinitarian-three-co-equal-persons + modalist-collapse + Arian-created-being; the substantial-Son's-eternal-submission preserved in incarnation. 16 members.
